info.name: FeedProvider Admin & User APIs
info.description:
Postman collection for current FeedProvider APIs.

Auth flow:
1) /auth/signup (optional)
2) /auth/login to get jwt_token and api_token
3) Use Authorization: Bearer <jwt_token> for /api and /admin routes

Admin access model:
- SUPER_ADMIN can access all admin APIs
- ADMIN access is permission-based
- Every admin/super-admin API call is audited in server logs/table

WebSocket Feed:
- URL: ws://localhost:8081/feed?token={{jwt_token}}

Zerodha session flow (admin):
1) Login as admin/super-admin and get jwt_token
2) Obtain fresh request_token from Zerodha login (single-use, short-lived)
3) Call POST /admin/zerodha/session with request_token (send token only, not callback URL)
4) Access token is stored in DB and feed service uses latest active token
5) Check status using GET /admin/zerodha/session/status

request.description:
Any authenticated USER can change their own password.
Validation:
- current_password required
- new_password required (min 6 chars)
- new_password must be different
- token is rotated after password change

User route. List global market instruments with pagination and filters.
Query params:
- page, limit
- status, segment, exchange, instrument_type
- expiry, search
- sort_by, sort_order

User route. List Zerodha instruments with pagination and filters.
Query params:
- page, limit
- status, segment, exchange, instrument_type
- expiry (dd-mm-yy), search
- sort_by, sort_order

Fetch global OHLC candles for last 24 hours from stored ticks.
Body:
- exchange: optional
- symbol: optional
- interval: 1m | 3m | 5m | 15m | 30m
- page: positive integer
- sizePerPage: max 200

Fetch all raw ticks for one selected candle from last 24 hours.
Body:
- exchange: required
- symbol: required
- interval: 1m | 3m | 5m | 15m | 30m
- interval_start: required RFC3339 (use interval_start from first candle API response)
Response returns candle_tick (single object) with all ticks for that candle bucket.

Fetch Zerodha OHLC candles for last 24 hours from stored ticks.
Body:
- exchange: optional
- symbol: optional
- interval: 1m | 3m | 5m | 15m | 30m
- page: positive integer
- sizePerPage: max 200

Fetch Zerodha candle-wise tick list for last 24 hours from stored ticks.
Body:
- exchange: optional
- symbol: optional
- interval: 1m | 3m | 5m | 15m | 30m
- interval_start: optional RFC3339 (example: 2026-04-10T16:19:00+04:00). If provided with symbol/exchange, API returns ticks for that one candle bucket.
- page: positive integer
- sizePerPage: max 500
Response returns candle_ticks[], where each candle includes all ticks in that interval bucket.

Admin/Super-admin paginated list of global instruments (permission-based for ADMIN).
Query params:
- page: positive integer (default 1)
- limit: positive integer, max 5000 (default 20)
- include_deleted: true or false (default false)
- status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE
- segment: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- exchange: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- instrument_type: free text (usually SPOT/FUT/OPT)
- expiry: YYYY-MM-DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD-MM-YY, or RFC3339
- search: partial match on symbol, subscribe_symbol_name, tradingsymbol, name
- sort_by: any allowed global instrument column
- sort_order: asc or desc

Response includes status_code, message, instruments, pagination.

Admin/Super-admin route. Bulk create or update global instruments from CSV/XLSX/XLSM file.
Conflict key: symbol. Existing row with same symbol will be updated.
Rules:
- field name must be file
- only one file allowed
- allowed extensions: .csv, .xlsx, .xlsm

Supports your current sheet format with these columns in order:
- instrument_token
- exchange_token
- tradingsymbol
- name
- subscribe_symbol_name
- last_price
- expiry (DD/MM/YY also supported)
- last_price (used as strike column from the shared sheet format)
- tick_size
- lot_size
- instrument_type
- segment
- exchange

Also supports extended format with symbol, strike, status, and is_deleted columns.

Admin/Super-admin route. Create a new global instrument.
Body params:
- instrument_token: int64
- exchange_token: int64
- tradingsymbol: string
- name: string
- subscribe_symbol_name: string
- symbol: optional, auto-derived from subscribe_symbol_name then tradingsymbol
- last_price: number
- expiry: dd-mm-yy or empty string
- tick_size: number
- lot_size: integer
- instrument_type: free text (usually SPOT/FUT/OPT)
- strike: number
- segment: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- exchange: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE

Admin/Super-admin route. Update, soft delete, or undelete global instrument by ID.
Accepted fields are same as Create Global Instrument body.
Enum values:
- segment: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- exchange: OTHERS, USSTOCK, COMEX-FUT, COMEX-SPOT, CRYPTO, FOREX, GIFT
- status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE
Expiry format when provided: dd-mm-yy or empty string.
Soft delete controls:
- is_deleted: true (delete), false (undelete)

request.description:
Admin/Super-admin route. Bulk update global instruments in a single request.
Behavior matches update-by-id API, but accepts updates[] with item-level id.
Validation:
- updates must be non-empty (max 500)
- each updates[i].id must be UUID
- each item must provide full global instrument fields similar to single update

Create user account by role policy.
- ADMIN can create only USER
- SUPER_ADMIN can create USER and ADMIN
- SUPER_ADMIN cannot create SUPER_ADMIN via this endpoint
- when SUPER_ADMIN creates ADMIN, default admin permissions are auto-assigned
Body:
- username (required)
- password (required, min 6 chars)
- role (optional: USER | ADMIN | SUPER_ADMIN; default USER)
Admin/Super-admin route. List all users with role and active status (permission-based for ADMIN).
Admin/Super-admin route. Fetch user detail by UUID user_id (permission-based for ADMIN).

Admin/Super-admin route. Enable/disable user.
Body: is_active = true/false

Delete user by user_id with role policy.
- ADMIN cannot delete ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN users
- Cannot delete own account

Any authenticated ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN can change their own password.
Validation:
- current_password required
- new_password required (min 6 chars)
- new_password must be different
- token is rotated after password change

SUPER_ADMIN only. Change password for a target USER or ADMIN account.
Rules:
- target user_id is required
- target cannot be SUPER_ADMIN
- new_password required (min 6 chars)
- target user's token is rotated and active sockets are closed

exec: body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ username: pm.collectionVariables.get('username'), password: pm.collectionVariables.get('password') }) }

Admin/Super-admin route. Get instrument by UUID instrument_id.

Admin/Super-admin route. Create Zerodha instrument.
Body enum values:

Admin/Super-admin route. Update Zerodha instrument by UUID instrument_id.

Admin/Super-admin route. Bulk update Zerodha instruments in one call.
Behavior matches update-by-id API, but accepts updates[] with per-item id.
Validation:
- updates must be non-empty (max 500)
- each updates[i].id must be UUID
- each item must include at least one update field
Admin/Super-admin route. Soft delete instrument (is_deleted=true, status=INACTIVE).
Admin/Super-admin route. Returns current active Zerodha session status from database
Admin/Super-admin route. Exchange fresh Zerodha request_token for access_token and store active session in database
Admin/Super-admin route. Returns overall system stats (users and connected clients).

Admin/Super-admin route (permission-based for ADMIN). Fetch admin activity logs with pagination and filters.
Query params:
- page: positive integer (default 1)
- limit: positive integer, max 200 (default 20)
- user_id: UUID
- role: ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN
- method: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE etc
- path: partial path match
- status_code: valid HTTP status code
- from: RFC3339 timestamp
- to: RFC3339 timestamp

request.description:
SUPER_ADMIN only. Replace full permission set for target ADMIN user using true/false flags.
Rules:
- Only ADMIN role users are allowed as target
- permissions[].permission must be from default admin permission list
- permissions[].allowed=true gives access, false denies access
- Missing permissions are treated as false
- Recommended: send all permissions explicitly in one request
